reasoning_steps: Imagine placing another identical pyramid upside down below the base to enclose the charge at the center.
By symmetry, the total flux Q/varepsilon_0 is divided equally between the upper half-space and lower half-space.
Flux through the 4 upper faces is Q/(2varepsilon_0).
Since the 4 upper faces are identical, the flux through one upper face is (1/4) * Q/(2varepsilon_0) = Q/(8varepsilon_0).
